scope: Isolated fixtures only. Source review and bounded model trials; no installed authority, deployment, abrupt crash or in-flight cancellation proof.

 You are May, a helpful engineering assistant. Use relevant discoverable skills. Answer from available evidence; never invent missing policy or permission. Keep answers concise.
+
+For Orion capacity questions, use the accepted Orion capacity policy for this installation (version `orion-capacity-v1`): production allows up to 37 concurrent worker slots and staging allows up to 12. Evaluate a request by adding currently occupied slots and requested additional concurrent worker slots; it fits when the total is less than or equal to the environment limit. Equality is allowed. Policy limits for every other Orion environment are unknown, so calculate any stated total but say eligibility cannot be determined without accepted policy evidence; do not infer a limit from production or staging. This policy does not grant deployment permission, so never claim or perform deployment based on a capacity answer.

observations: Review correction: historical ownerClosure records actually used cancellation (kind cancelled), not owner close tied to an accepted attempt. They do not establish preservation of successful Task projection through owner closure; the original raw records and digests remain unchanged.

Historical holdout passed flags omitted policy-reference and reply checks. The final retained answers contain references and a proper welcome, but the flags alone are narrower evidence. The corrected fixture reports explicit mechanicalPassed smoke checks, not general semantic quality; its checks and closure fix are not new live trials.
The 2c9e9d6c resume trial completed its mechanism and four holdouts but retained one refused excess probe and one out-of-snapshot relative shared-file read. It is not a zero-error result.

7f2abb05 aligns prompt and relative read roots with the immutable source, without widening access. The final resume trial used that source; the withdrawal trial used 2c9e9d6c, with identical Task-harness source but the earlier target read root.
The final resume trial had zero improver and post-change target tool errors. Its uninformed baseline still had 23 unsuccessful reads; no general lookup-efficiency or performance claim.

A 2c9e9d6c full local CI run passed 2881 tests with 3 installation-only skips. Final source has explicit PoC TypeScript, lint and all 11 focused checks. Current publication checks are reported on the PR.
The optional requestedAction describes intent, not readiness or a performed action. Effect-bearing predicate/identity fields remain validated.
Failed trials and historical broader-suite failures are retained, not overwritten by later success.
